probes.question: Which disc diameter was adopted in December 1979?
True or false: Kees Immink says the EFM code format was already decided when the 120 mm size was adopted.

image.alt: Flat illustration of a compact disc with concentric tracks and a beam of light touching it.

body.claim: The official Philips history says the CD's capacity was specified by Sony executive Norio Ohga so it could contain the entirety of Beethoven's Ninth Symphony.
body.why: Philips chief engineer Kees Immink says this is a myth. The EFM code format had not yet been decided in December 1979, when the 120 mm size was adopted.
